headline: Courtois extends Real Madrid contract to 2028
facts: Real Madrid confirmed Courtois has signed an extension that keeps him at the club until 30 June 2028.
His previous deal was due to expire at the end of the current season.
He is 34 and has been the club's No. 1 since 2018, with 348 appearances.
background: Courtois joined from Chelsea in 2018 and replaced Keylor Navas; he was MVP of the 2022 Champions League final win over Liverpool.

headline: Mourinho tells Vinicius to forget the summer: 'It's the past'
facts: Mourinho said Vinicius was wrong to blame his poor form on a lack of preparation, but did not attack his honesty.
Vinicius has one goal in eight LaLiga games and has lost his starting place to new signing Yan Diomande.
He returns from a four-game ban for the Celta Vigo match on Saturday 21 November.
background: Vinicius signed a new long-term deal in August after a summer of Arsenal interest; Brazil went out in the World Cup round of 16 in July.
footage_terms: Real Madrid Celta Vigo preview Mourinho

headline: Tchouameni agrees new Real Madrid contract through 2032
facts: Real Madrid announced Tchouameni will stay linked to the club until 30 June 2032.
The French midfielder has improved this season under Mourinho after an injury at the World Cup.
He left the France squad earlier this month with a muscle problem but trained with Madrid on announcement day.
background: Madrid signed him from Monaco in 2022 for about 80 million euros, beating Liverpool and PSG; some Bernabeu fans whistled him in recent seasons.

headline: Guler scores epic free kick for Turkiye, then signs new Madrid deal to 2032
facts: Guler scored a spectacular free kick for Turkiye against Belgium, though Turkiye still lost.
Real Madrid confirmed a new six-year contract running to 30 June 2032.
In LaLiga he has 3 goals and 4 assists in 12 games; he also created two goals off the bench in the 4-3 win at Roma.
background: The 21-year-old joined in 2023 and has made 126 appearances and won five trophies; he is one of Mourinho's standout players this season.
footage_terms: Arda Guler free kick Belgium Turkiye

headline: JJ Gabriel quits Man United as Real Madrid move nears, United threaten legal action
facts: The 16-year-old confirmed his Man United exit in an Instagram video; sources told ESPN he is on the brink of joining Real Madrid.
United would consider legal action if evidence shows he was illegally approached while under contract, ESPN reported on 18 November.
Sky Sports said on 4 November that a verbal agreement existed and Madrid want to sign him in January.
background: He joined United's academy in 2020 at age 10 and asked to leave in September; his EU passport lets him join any European club, and January is the first registration window for him.
footage_terms: JJ Gabriel Manchester United youth goals
Manchester United academy JJ Gabriel highlights

headline: Vinicius says he felt 'overwhelmed' by Arsenal interest and trained less in summer
facts: Vinicius said his slow start (one goal in 12 appearances) is partly down to feeling overwhelmed by transfer speculation.
He also blamed Brazil's World Cup round-of-16 exit and training less on holiday.
He signed a new deal in August that keeps him at Madrid until at least 2032.
background: Arsenal were among the clubs linked as his contract entered its final year; he lost his starting left-wing spot to Yan Diomande during his ban.

headline: Vinicius hits Brazil hat trick in 21 minutes in 7-0 win over Singapore
facts: Vinicius scored a hat trick inside the first 21 minutes of Brazil's 7-0 friendly win; Endrick, Estevao and Rayan also scored.
It was his first international hat trick; he also scored both goals in a 3-2 loss to Japan two days earlier.
He has 19 goals in 59 Brazil games but only one in 12 appearances for Real Madrid this season.
background: Ancelotti, now Brazil coach, worked with Vinicius at Real Madrid and won the Champions League with him.

headline: Vinicius sent off for hair pull, gets four-game ban and misses the Clasico
facts: Vinicius scored at Villarreal but the goal was disallowed and he was red-carded after VAR showed him pulling Nathan Saliba's hair; Madrid still won 1-0.
The federation gave two games for violent conduct and two for his reaction to the referee; the ban does not cover the Champions League.
He missed the games against Sevilla, Barcelona, Racing Santander and Valencia; he apologised on social media.
background: Mourinho questioned why the committee announced the punishment just before a big match; Yan Diomande scored the winner at Villarreal.
footage_terms: Vinicius red card Villarreal hair pull

headline: Mourinho: Vinicius should have left Real Madrid in the summer
facts: Sky Sports reports Mourinho said Vinicius should have left Real Madrid in the summer.
He argued the player would have received more respect in another country.
Arsenal were one of the clubs interested in the winger.
background: Vinicius later signed a long-term deal in August to stay; Mourinho returned as Madrid coach in July 2026.
footage_terms: Mourinho press conference Real Madrid October 2026

headline: Real Madrid crush Leipzig 4-1 as Vinicius is whistled by his own fans
facts: Bernardo Silva scored his first Madrid goal, then Guler, Mbappe and Diomande scored in a 4-1 Bernabeu win.
Diomande came on for Vinicius and volleyed in the final goal against his former club.
Some home fans whistled Vinicius when he was substituted; Mourinho said whistles at home hurt a player.
background: Diomande left Leipzig in the summer for a reported fee of up to 140 million euros and had failed to score in his first eight Madrid games.

headline: Mourinho warns Vinicius he is not guaranteed a start when ban ends
facts: Mourinho said Vinicius will not automatically return to the lineup after the suspension.
Madrid won all three league games without him; Diomande has four goals and three assists in six games.
Vinicius was criticised at AEK Athens and substituted after Bellingham's equaliser.
background: Rodrygo, Raul Asencio and Ferland Mendy were also out injured at that point; Madrid were third in LaLiga.
footage_terms: Real Madrid training Mourinho press conference

headline: Mbappe double wins the Clasico 2-1 at Barcelona
facts: Mbappe scored in the 41st minute (deflected) and again in the 87th; Raphinha scored for Barcelona.
It was Madrid's first win at Barcelona in three years and ended Barcelona's nine-game winning start.
Mourinho criticised VAR for not reviewing Cancelo's challenge on Diomande; Camavinga burst past Mbappe to set up the winner.
background: Barcelona had lost 4-2 to PSG in the Champions League days earlier; Madrid closed to three points behind the leaders.

headline: Mbappe reaches 100 Real Madrid goals in 116 games
facts: Mbappe hit 100 Madrid goals with his Clasico double.
It took him 116 matches, making him the fifth-fastest Madrid player to the mark.
ESPN's own figures show Ronaldo needed 106 games, despite the headline claim.
background: Ronaldo is Madrid's all-time top scorer with 451 goals in 438 matches.
footage_terms: Mbappe vs Ronaldo goals Real Madrid

headline: Kane edges Mbappe for the 2026 Ballon d'Or by 28 points
facts: Kane won with 1,055 points to Mbappe's 1,027; Kane had 40 first-place votes to Mbappe's 23.
Bellingham finished 11th, Vinicius 17th and Marc Cucurella 18th.
L'Equipe ranked it the fourth-closest vote in the award's 70-year history.
background: Mbappe led LaLiga with 25 goals and won the World Cup Golden Boot with 10 goals, but won no trophies with Madrid or France last season.

headline: Bellingham scores 50th Real Madrid goal and passes Zidane
facts: Bellingham chipped the Racing Santander goalkeeper for his 50th Real Madrid goal.
Sky reports the goal moved him past Zinedine Zidane's tally for the club.
Madrid won the league game 3-0.
background: Bellingham is 23 and joined from Borussia Dortmund; Zidane, now France coach, won three Champions Leagues as Madrid manager.

headline: Real Madrid beat Roma 4-3 after trailing 3-1 with seven minutes left
facts: Roma led 3-1 through De Roon and two Malen goals before Espi, Endrick and Rudiger scored in the last seven minutes.
Arda Guler delivered the corner for Endrick and another set piece for Rudiger's winner.
Mbappe's goal came in his 100th Champions League appearance, making him the youngest to reach 100.
background: Mourinho returned to a former club, where a banner honoured his Conference League win with Roma.

headline: Real Madrid thump Sevilla 4-1 while Vinicius serves ban
facts: Guler scored in the 30th minute, Mbappe in the 37th and 63rd (penalty), and Diomande in the 82nd; Bueno scored for Sevilla.
Sky Sports' highlights headline described an Mbappe goal and Panenka penalty.
It was Madrid's first league game after Vinicius's red card.
background: Madrid had lost to Atletico 2-1 on 20 September and to Betis earlier in the season.

headline: AEK Athens 2-3 Real Madrid: Valverde wins it in stoppage time
facts: Madrid fell behind twice; Bellingham and Mbappe equalised and Valverde scored in the 92nd minute.
AEK's Koita was shown a red card after protesting at the final whistle.
Bellingham became the youngest player to score in seven straight Champions League seasons; Mourinho called him a unique midfielder.
background: It was Madrid's second dramatic away comeback under Mourinho after the 4-3 win at Roma.
footage_terms: Mourinho Bellingham one of a kind

headline: Valencia 0-3 Real Madrid: eighth straight win, Guler stars
facts: Valverde (28'), Guler (36') and Mbappe (75') scored at Mestalla.
Madrid had 11 shots on target to Valencia's two and an expected-goals edge of 2.26 to 0.16.
ESPN's recap called it Madrid's eighth straight win.
background: Valencia were 19th with nine points; Madrid's league table position was reported differently on the page, so the title-race gap is unverified.

headline: Police identify Barcelona fan who hit Camavinga with a flag at the Clasico
facts: Police identified the Barcelona supporter who struck Camavinga with a flag in the 87th minute while Madrid celebrated.
LaLiga reported it to the federation's disciplinary and anti-violence bodies; a fine up to 60,000 euros and a 6-24 month stadium ban are possible.
Barcelona suspended the Gol 1957 section's activity for the Alaves league match.
background: Camavinga played a key role in the winning goal, bursting forward from deep to set up Mbappe.
footage_terms: Barcelona Real Madrid Clasico fan incident

headline: Camavinga credits Mourinho for confidence boost after Harvard summer course
facts: Camavinga said Mourinho helped him mature and boosted his confidence.
He spent part of the summer on a short business course at Harvard Business School.
He says he now arrives two to three hours early for gym work.
background: He was left out of France's 2026 World Cup squad and was criticised after a second yellow card in the 3-4 second-leg loss to Bayern that knocked Madrid out of last season's Champions League.

headline: Endrick wants minutes as Mourinho hopes Ancelotti plays him for Brazil
facts: Endrick has played only 141 minutes for Madrid this season and started one of seven games.
Mourinho said he would be grateful if Ancelotti gave Endrick minutes in Brazil's friendlies.
Endrick said he does not know what happens in January and that it is in God's hands; Mourinho says his future is at the Bernabeu.
background: Endrick, 20, spent time on loan at Lyon; Roma and Arsenal were reported to be considering him (via ESPN's transfer roundup on 20 November).

headline: Trent Alexander-Arnold on the bench: should Liverpool re-sign him?
facts: He has started five of 16 games this season and played once in the Champions League.
Mourinho's arrival pushed him behind Federico Valverde and Denzel Dumfries at right back.
He has started 18 of a possible 50 LaLiga games since joining Madrid.
background: He left Liverpool in 2025 for Madrid, who paid 12 million euros; his contract runs to 2031.

headline: Rafael Nadal appointed to Real Madrid board
facts: Real Madrid appointed Nadal to its board of directors.
The club said his values of talent, discipline, humility and solidarity reflect its own identity.
He shared a childhood photo of himself in a Madrid shirt.
background: Nadal won 22 Grand Slams and retired in 2024; earlier in 2026 he called reports of a presidency run untrue.

headline: Oviedo fan gets suspended sentence for racist abuse of Mbappe
facts: The Provincial Court of Asturias gave the fan a suspended 11-month prison term, a stadium ban and a fine for a hate crime.
The abuse happened at Oviedo on 24 August 2025 after Mbappe's opening goal.
Real Madrid acted as private prosecutor.
background: Madrid say the ruling follows earlier convictions for racist abuse of its players at Mestalla, Son Moix, Vallecas and Jose Zorrilla.

headline: Zidane dismisses reports of rift with captain Mbappe as 'nonsense'
facts: Reports claimed Mbappe was unhappy on the left wing in September and communication with Zidane was limited.
Zidane called the speculation nonsense and said the relationship is going well.
Italy beat France 3-1, Zidane's first defeat in five games as coach.
background: Zidane took over from Didier Deschamps after the 2026 World Cup; he won three Champions Leagues as Real Madrid manager.

headline: Mbappe hamstring problem rules him out of France-Italy
facts: Mbappe sat out training with a hamstring issue and Zidane confirmed he would miss the Italy game in Milan.
Zidane called it nothing major and expected him fit for Sunday's game against Turkiye.
Italy coach Mancini joked that Mbappe should avoid risks given Madrid's upcoming Champions League game.
background: France lead their Nations League group; Zidane described not taking risks with the Real Madrid striker.
footage_terms: France Turkiye Nations League Bordeaux highlights

headline: ESPN's 10 Best ranks Bellingham second and Mbappe sixth in the world
facts: ESPN's November ranking puts Lamine Yamal first, Bellingham second and Mbappe sixth.
Kane, the Ballon d'Or winner, is fifth; ESPN notes a finishing slump.
The write-up calls Mbappe a weak presser despite elite expected goals.
background: Bellingham finished 11th in the Ballon d'Or vote despite this ranking.

headline: Tuchel: Bellingham relationship 'in a good place'; brother Jobe called up for England
facts: Tuchel said his up-and-down relationship with Bellingham is now in a good place.
Jobe Bellingham got a surprise England call-up; Tuchel says Jude pushed for it.
They would be the first brothers to play for England together since Gary and Phil Neville in 2007.
background: Tuchel apologised last year for remarks about the elder Bellingham's conduct; Jude has won England's player of the year award twice under him.

headline: Real Madrid women beat Inter 3-1 in the Champions League
facts: Signe Bruun scored twice, including a stoppage-time penalty won by Linda Caicedo.
Madrid had 25 shots, and Inter's keeper made nine saves.
They are fourth in the group on nine points from five games, unbeaten.
background: Madrid were knocked out in the quarterfinals in each of the last two seasons, by Arsenal and Barcelona.

headline: Real Madrid tipped to trigger Nico Paz's 80 million euro clause next summer
facts: ESPN's roundup, citing Mundo Deportivo, says Madrid are expected to trigger Paz's 80 million euro release clause next summer.
Paz, 22, has six goals and eight assists in 14 appearances for Como.
This is a rumour, not a confirmed deal.
background: ESPN has profiled Paz as the heir to Messi's Argentina No. 10 shirt.

headline: Rudiger could leave next year, Madrid to discuss his future (Marca via ESPN)
facts: ESPN's transfer roundup, citing Marca, says Rudiger could leave next year.
Real Madrid plan to discuss his future before the summer window.
This is a rumour, not confirmed.
background: Rudiger scored the 90th-minute winner at Roma on 14 October.

headline: Mbappe set to attend NFL game in Madrid, Bengals' Higgins says he is a fan
facts: Bengals receiver Tee Higgins said he is impressed by Mbappe's skill.
He said he is glad Mbappe will attend the Bengals-Falcons NFL game in Madrid.
He called the idea 'dope'.
background: Mbappe is Real Madrid's star forward and finished second in the 2026 Ballon d'Or.
